graph.title: LEGO Friends Advent Calendar 2012
notes: Page 1 is the back cover (warnings, LEGOFriends.com, trademark text, a promotional picture of a plane over a city). It has no building step, so no pieces or joins were added.
The claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive MCP servers need authorization through the claude.ai connector settings. They are unavailable until then. This task did not need them.
This page is advertising only. It shows the five Friends characters and the sets 3184, 3189, 3061 and 3315. It has no building step, so no pieces or joins were added.

This is not a real problem. The booklet I was given has only two pages, and neither has a building step. Page 1 is the back cover, with warnings and a promotional picture. Page 2 is advertising for sets 3184, 3189, 3061 and 3315.

The parts list inventories 206 pieces, but none of those pieces is placed on any page I was shown. Adding them would mean inventing ids, `rests_on` relations and joins that no page shows, so I added none.
The pieces would come from the day-by-day build pages of the advent calendar, which were not provided. If those pages are sent, I will record the pieces and joins from them.
The mismatch is not a real problem for the pages supplied. The booklet has two pages and neither has a building step. Page 1 is the back cover and page 2 is advertising for other sets.
No piece is placed on any page, so the graph has no pieces. The missing-piece report only reflects that the parts list covers the whole calendar and the build pages were not provided.
I did not invent pieces to match the inventory. Doing so would add ids, `rests_on` relations and joins that no page shows.
If the day-by-day build pages are supplied, I will record the pieces and joins from them.
